musee.name: Le grand hall du musée · The museum's great hall
musee.alt: The great hall of the village museum, seen from the near left and slightly above: cream stone columns, a polished pale marble floor, a glass pyramid skylight, a grand staircase rising to an upper gallery balcony and a draped white statue wearing a tiny visitor badge. Up on the balcony a young woman in a yellow dress waves a red scarf over the balustrade, and beside her a photographer in a green cardigan looks through a big old wooden bellows camera. On the left a tour guide in sunglasses and a blue blazer holds up a folded umbrella for his group, a white-haired granny with her hair in a bun and a pearl necklace points to her cabinet of colorful seashells, and a young cleaner in blue overalls vacuums the floor in front of a huge gilt-framed landscape masterpiece. In the middle an artist in a flowered smock stands at her easel holding a steaming cup of tea, and in front Monsieur Verbe in a red beret sits on a bench turning a big wooden hourglass, passing the time. On the right a jolly man dressed as a pirate raises his fist in delight at a framed painting, a gray cat sits beside a glass case holding a little model of the museum while a guard smiles at it, and a man in a tweed vest puffs past carrying a tall white obelisk. A yellow door with a crayon on the left wall leads to the art workshop, a dark green door at the back leads to the detective gallery, and a white door with a microscope sign on the right wall leads to the medicine gallery.

doors.hint: the yellow door with the crayon on the left wall, to the art workshop

doors.label: Les romans policiers
doors.hint: the dark green door at the back, to the detective gallery

doors.hint: the white door with the microscope sign on the right wall, to the medicine gallery

doors.label: La galerie de peinture
doors.hint: the grand staircase behind the statue, up to the first-floor painting gallery

atelier.name: L'atelier des enfants · The children's workshop
atelier.alt: The museum's children's workshop on Saturday art club, seen from the near left: sunflower-yellow walls hung with children's paintings, paper ceiling lamps, low wooden tables with paint pots and crayons, a green play mat and a giant crayon used as a coat stand. At the back left a lady illustrator in glasses holds open a huge picture book with a blue whale, a girl with a black bob spins a round zoetrope drum with little galloping horses, and in the teddy hospital corner a girl tends a sick doll tucked into a toy bed with a thermometer and a hot-water bottle. In front a little girl in a toy nurse's apron sticks a bandage on her teddy bear, and a red-pigtailed girl holds up two batteries beside her stopped toy robot with its battery hatch open. On the right a boy holds up his crayon drawing of a sunny beach, another dips a fat paintbrush into a frying pan of blue paint, a boy kneeling on the mat paints a red flower on a sheet of white paper, and two boys carry a smiling rag doll with a bandaged knee and an arm sling on a little toy stretcher. A slate-blue door on the left leads back to the great hall.

doors.label: Le grand hall
doors.hint: the slate-blue door on the left wall, back to the great hall

enquete.name: Les romans policiers · Detective stories
enquete.alt: The museum's detective-story gallery on its 'solve the mystery' family day, seen from the near left: bottle-green walls, brass picture lamps, red velvet ropes on brass posts and a giant deerstalker hat over the striped puppet booth. At the back left a cheerful lady in a black dress holds up a blue prize rosette behind the iron bars of the old prison-cell exhibit while her friend photographs her; at a café table two old ladies frown comically and tug the one teacup. In the middle Monsieur Verbe in a red beret plays the fairy-tale witch in the puppet booth, dipping a red apple into a bubbling green cauldron beside a hobby-horse pony and a girl in a witch hat. At the back right a waxwork gentleman-criminal in a top hat and mask holds a popsicle and a little bell, and a waxwork villain in a cloak stands empty-handed in a tall glass case with sand at his boots. In front a young woman in a red cape raises a lantern and magnifying glass, a giant striped party popper bursts confetti as a girl in yellow claps, a girl offers a cookie to a little white dog guarding a small white model of the Taj Mahal, and a detective in a deerstalker studies a red jewel cushion smeared with whipped cream. On the right a man in a Hawaiian shirt rushes the gift-shop postcard racks, a grinning masked burglar tiptoes off with a small painting and a fishing rod with a green lure, and a man in a bow tie clutches his hot cheeks beside a flame-red book on a lectern. Doors: slate-blue on the left back to the great hall, iron-studded oak at the back, plain gray at the back right.

doors.label: Le grand hall
doors.hint: the slate-blue door on the left wall, back to the great hall

doors.label: La salle d'armes
doors.hint: the iron-studded oak door at the back, to the armory hall

doors.label: Couloir des mots 1
doors.hint: the plain gray door at the back right, to the word corridor

armes.name: La salle d'armes · The armory hall
armes.alt: The museum's armory hall, seen from the near left: gray stone walls, iron chandeliers with white bulbs, a blue banner with a smiling golden lion and one unbroken red velvet rope on brass posts running in front of the displays; every weapon is an antique display object and nobody holds one. On the far left a life-size figure of Sir Lancelot in a blue tunic with a white cross stands on a stone plinth beside his tall striped jousting lance. On the back wall a big bronze arm sticks out of the stone, holding up an old mace, while a little girl points up at it; a ginger cat mews at the feet of an empty suit of armor, and a forester lady holds an ash sprig up to an old ax on a wall rack. In front a lady offers a candy from a paper bag beside a small glass case with a round black cartoon bomb, its fuse unlit, and a gray-haired lady hands a coin to a guard beside a long shining sword lying on a red velvet cushion. On the right an old gentleman points a yardstick at a jeweled dagger on a cushion, a guard dozes on a stool below an old rifle on wall pegs, a man in a green cardigan makes a peace sign by the small pistol case, a boy holds up a toy Noah's ark toward the longbow on the wall, and a potter holds up a little clay shield beside a big round painted shield. Door: bottle-green on the left wall, back to the detective-story gallery.

doors.label: Les romans policiers
doors.hint: the bottle-green door on the left wall, back to the detective-story gallery

medecine.name: La galerie de la médecine · The history-of-medicine gallery
medecine.alt: The museum's history-of-medicine gallery, seen from the near left: white and pale teal tiles, honey-wood apothecary cabinets, milk-glass ceiling globes and glass cases. At the back left a scientist peers into a giant brass microscope while her white-haired father in a white coat chats with a friend; a nurse in an old-fashioned cap holds up a giant plain white tube by a sanatorium chair with a plaid blanket; in front a girl in a lab coat sprays a giant green plush germ. In the middle a girl with an ice-cream cone yawns and her two friends yawn too, a farm lady in a headscarf shows an empty wooden bowl beside an empty grain bin of dry wheat stalks, and at the back a girl pours more tea beside a big hourglass whose sand has all run out. In the center a mischievous long-nosed Pinocchio puppet stands in a glass case, and a cheerful boy on a bench reads a small gray blood-sugar meter beside a bowl of sugar cubes. On the right a Victorian doctor in a top hat and big white collar grips the curved iron pipe of an old black water pump, a boy lifts a giant red blood-cell model over his head, a bearded man in a white coat shows a red crab in a case under a star chart, and a boy walks his collie on a red lead past a case holding an empty old bottle and a glass of water. Doors: slate-blue on the left wall, back to the museum hall; plain gray at the back right, to the health wall-text room.

doors.label: Le grand hall
doors.hint: the slate-blue door on the left wall, back to the museum hall

doors.label: L'hospice
doors.hint: the plain gray door at the back right, to the old hospital ward

mots_delits.name: Le couloir des mots (1) · Word corridor 1 (text only)
mots_delits.alt: A quiet, plain word corridor of the museum seen straight down its length: pale gray walls, pale oak floor and three round milk-glass lamps. Small blank cream plaques with brass screws hang at different heights along both walls, five on the left and eight on the right; two low wooden lecterns in the middle each hold one more blank plaque. Nothing is depicted: the words here exist only as wall text. A potted fern stands on a bench against the back wall. Doors: plain gray on the left wall, back to the detective-story gallery; plain gray at the back, to the storybook courtroom.

doors.hint: the plain gray door on the left wall, back to the detective-story gallery

doors.hint: the plain gray door at the back, to the storybook courtroom

mots_deuil.name: Le couloir des mots (2) · Word corridor 2 (text only)
mots_deuil.alt: The quiet second room of the museum word corridor, softly lit by a round skylight: pale gray walls with a dark-blue baseboard and a pale oak plank floor. Small blank cream plaques with brass screws hang at different heights: two on the left wall, four in a zigzag on the back wall and seven along the right wall; two wooden lecterns in the middle each hold one more blank plaque. Nothing is depicted: the words here exist only as wall text. A wooden bench stands under the back wall and a potted olive tree in the back right corner. Door: plain gray on the left wall, back to the old hospital ward.

doors.hint: the plain gray door on the left wall, back to the old hospital ward

tribunal.name: Le tribunal des romans · The storybook courtroom
tribunal.alt: A museum's reconstructed old courtroom on a family mock-trial day, dark wood paneling and a green-and-cream tiled floor under brass lamps. A smiling white-haired judge sits at the raised bench at the back. In the jury box at the back left a lady juror in a feathered hat wags her finger at a startled lawyer in a white wig. On a bench a cartoon criminal in a striped shirt and eye mask sips tea from a tin mug, and in the left foreground a big hairy brute looks sheepish over a china teapot and a smashed cup. In the middle a grinning jailbird signs a paper with an enormous feather quill pen. On the right a mafioso in a pinstripe suit poses with a tennis racket, a stalk of celery in a black mask and striped shirt sits in the dock, and a masked burglar tiptoes off with a giant wedge of brie. A small antique revolver lies on a turning stand in a glass case at the right, and three spectators on the upper balcony peer through opera glasses. Doors: plain gray on the left wall, back to the word corridor; red wood with a ship lantern at the back right, to the harbor tavern.

doors.label: Couloir des mots 1
doors.hint: the plain gray door on the left wall, back to the word corridor

doors.label: La taverne
doors.hint: the red wooden door with the ship lantern at the back right, to the harbor tavern

taverne.name: La taverne du port · The harbor tavern
taverne.alt: A museum's life-size reconstructed harbor tavern with timber beams, whitewashed walls, fishing nets, a ship's wheel and hanging ship lanterns; pewter mugs stand untouched on a shelf behind the bar and nobody is drinking. By the red door on the left a laughing young woman gives her grinning boyfriend a playful cartoon slap, little stars bursting, while he holds a bunch of flowers. In front of them a comic dust cloud of a scuffle rolls around a big duffel bag, a laughing sailor in a red bandana in the middle of it, nobody hurt. On a table two little cartoon bulls in red boxing gloves spar on a giant apple core. In the middle a tipsy rosy-nosed sailor dances with a potted fir tree, and at the bar a tipsy old fisherman dozes with his nose in his soup. In front, a red-nosed old cook weeps as he peels a big sack of onions. On the right a white-bearded old man with a cold, unlit pipe in his teeth holds a brass tuba; there is no smoke. Doors: red wood on the left wall, back to the courtroom; an open archway at the back right with a gangway up to the pirate ship.

doors.label: Le tribunal
doors.hint: the red wooden door on the left wall, back to the storybook courtroom

doors.label: Le bateau pirate
doors.hint: the open archway and gangway at the back right, up to the pirate ship

bateau_pirate.name: Le bateau pirate · The pirate ship
bateau_pirate.alt: The main deck of a life-size wooden pirate ship standing in the museum's glass-roofed ship hall on a family dress-up day; there are no swords or cannons. High in the crow's nest at the upper left a person in a giant carrot costume keeps a lookout with cupped hands. A laughing pirate holds up his boot with a brass compass stuck to the sole. At the front left two dress-up children gaze at a shiny red toy car on a stack of cargo crates and sacks, and a sailor kneels at an open deck hatch, calling down into the dark hold. In the middle a helmsman in a tricorn hat steers at the big wooden wheel, and a smiling mother in a headscarf hugs the tall mast. On the raised deck at the right a dashing privateer in a plumed hat points out ahead, and two mischievous bandits grin and wave from the ship's little barred brig. A pirate kid opens a loot sack full of giant colorful buttons, a girl blows soap bubbles out of a round brass porthole, and a little rat in a red bandana sits on a barrel holding one big green pea. Door: the open doorway at the top of the gangway on the left, back to the harbor tavern.

doors.label: La taverne
doors.hint: the open doorway at the top of the gangway on the left, back to the harbor tavern

hospice.name: L'hospice d'autrefois · The old hospital ward
hospice.alt: A museum's reconstructed old hospital ward and bath-cure room with white tiled walls, tall windows and a pale tiled floor. At the back left a row of iron beds holds sniffly patients with thermometers and handkerchiefs while a nurse in a white cap brings a bowl of green pea soup. In front, a little girl on a stool holds a plush bunny whose cut tummy shows colorful play-dough stuffing, and a boy pulls back a white curtain to find a patch of wall oozing thick green goo. In the middle a happy mother sits on a green couch with her newborn baby beside a smiling mime in a red beret. On the right a big museum diorama shows a murky green river flowing down a hillside, carrying cartoon locusts on leaf rafts, and a man in an old striped bathing suit leaps out of a steamy steam room into an icy plunge pool. Doors: white with a round window at the left, back to the medicine gallery; plain gray at the back right, to the word corridor.

doors.label: La médecine
doors.hint: the white door with the round window at the left, back to the medicine gallery

doors.label: Couloir des mots 2
doors.hint: the plain gray door at the back right, to the word corridor

peinture.name: La galerie de peinture · The painting gallery
peinture.alt: The museum's first-floor painting gallery, seen from the near left: pale gray-blue walls, gilt-framed paintings and an oak parquet floor, with the top of the grand white staircase at the near left. In front a painter dries her hands on a red-and-white striped towel hung over her blank canvas, and a chef proudly holds up his frying pan beside a still-life painting of a frying pan. At the back left a young restorer dabs the mustache of a gentleman in an old portrait with a tiny brush, a gray-haired lady in a red dress and tap shoes tap-dances under a huge unicorn tapestry beside a giant paint tube used as a bench, and a restorer on a low scaffold cleans an arched fresco of swallows. In the middle a boy in a blue smock paints a still life of a pantry shelf of jam jars, and a boy points up at a rally-car race painted straight onto the wall. On the right a waiter pours orange juice onto his tray for the lady in a big portrait, a man sits posing with a model sailing ship and a gardener pushes an old reel mower over a striped exhibit lawn. At the front right a bearded man holds a frame round a giant ace of hearts, and a framer with a drum at his hip taps a frame corner with a drumstick. Doors: the staircase down at the near left, a white double door on the left wall, a cream glass door at the back and an iron-studded oak door on the right.

doors.label: Le grand hall
doors.hint: the grand staircase at the near left, down to the museum's great hall

doors.label: Les sculptures
doors.hint: the white double door on the left wall, to the sculpture gallery

doors.label: Le vernissage
doors.hint: the cream glass double door at the back, to the opening-night exhibition

doors.hint: the iron-studded oak door on the right, to the castle wing

sculpture.name: La galerie des sculptures · The sculpture gallery
sculpture.alt: The museum's sculpture gallery under a big skylight, seen from the near left: white walls, a pale travertine floor with an inlaid fish mosaic and white marble statues on plinths. At the left a schoolgirl sketches a big marble horse with a pigeon on its head, an academician in a gold-embroidered coat and bicorne shows her laurel wreath, and a grandma knits one patchwork blanket over two children on a bench. In the middle a girl kneeling on the mosaic squeals at a mouse, an artist carves swirls into a teak chair and an archaeologist brushes the dust off an old wooden clog. At the right a sculptor chisels a stone turtle, an attendant pulls a giant striped sock over a plinth, a young man unveils a plaster sculpture of bare feet and a silver living statue stands frozen on a box. At the front right a draftsman draws a daisy, and at a striped fine-arts stall a craftsman pours colored sand into bottles. A white door on the left wall leads back to the painting gallery.

doors.label: La galerie de peinture
doors.hint: the white door on the left wall, back to the painting gallery

vernissage.name: Le vernissage · The opening night
vernissage.alt: The museum's modern temporary exhibition hall on its opening night, seen from the near left: white walls, pale gray partitions, a polished concrete floor and spotlights on tracks, with a glass greenhouse nook of palms at the right. At the left a girl in a yellow dress points at a model of a world expo with a Ferris wheel, a man leans on a glass case of decorated eggs, a child wears a funny costume made from a crate and an old TV, and a woman in a lab coat draws up a big plan. At the back a boy wears headphones at the media-library screen, a grandpa and a girl put a rolled poster into a time capsule, and a board of old picture prints hangs on a partition. At the right a man brushes varnish onto a landscape painting, the young curator serves cake from a cake stand, a farmer holds open a catalog of cows, a see-through glass statue of a mule stands in its case, a boy shows off a sleek red scooter, and two music students play violin and cello by the greenhouse. A cream glass door on the left wall leads back to the painting gallery.

doors.label: La galerie de peinture
doors.hint: the cream glass door on the left wall, back to the painting gallery

chateau.name: La maquette du château · The castle model hall
chateau.alt: The museum's castle model hall, seen from the near left: pale honey-gray stone walls, gray flagstones and iron ring chandeliers, with a big model of a medieval castle on a long oak table. At the left a guard stands to attention in a striped sentry box, a girl with a long golden braid leans over the model's fortress wall, a boy sets out a little white picket fence, and a boy finds a fluffy blue toy yeti on the rim of a round stone pit. By the model's tall keep a mother wags her finger at her little boy, who sets a woolly toy ram on the rampart wall. At the back a girl shines a yellow flashlight so a huge castle shadow falls on the wall, and a boy rests his double bass by the model's corner bastion. In front a workman and a little girl push a big stone block on a cart, a wooden block is jammed in the open door of a canary's birdcage, a girl opens a treasure chest of gold coins on a wooden plinth, and a man polishes an old gilded carriage covered in pink roses. An oak door with iron studs on the left wall leads back to the painting gallery, a pointed stone archway at the back leads to the knights' hall, and a red-and-gold door at the back right leads to the throne room.

doors.label: La galerie de peinture
doors.hint: the oak door with iron studs on the left wall, back to the painting gallery

doors.label: Les chevaliers
doors.hint: the pointed stone archway at the back, to the knights' hall

doors.label: La salle du trône
doors.hint: the red-and-gold arched door at the back right, to the throne room

chevaliers.name: La salle des chevaliers · The knights' hall
chevaliers.alt: The castle's knights' hall, seen from the near left: pale stone walls hung with red, blue and gold heraldic banners, iron ring chandeliers, gray flagstones and a long red carpet down the middle. On the left a black crow perches on an old crusader's helmet on a wooden stand, and a girl in a red sweater peeks round a tall glass case holding a long pike; behind them stands an empty oak feasting table with pewter plates and a green dragon pitcher. Right of the carpet two riders on a tandem bicycle carry a green standard under a round blue emblem with a white lamb, and a knight in armor holds a garden shovel and raises a fist. Two children juggle clubs, a bodyguard in sunglasses stands beside a little girl in a yellow dress, and a storyteller dressed as Merlin chants with raised hands for two boys. A man in a green sweater holds a pool cue under a painted coat of arms, beside a glass cabinet of daggers in leather scabbards. In front a young squire holds up a big iron key with a helmet under his arm, a low glass case holds a plush saber-toothed tiger and a curved saber, and a musketeer hugs a plush moose. An oak door on the left wall leads back to the castle model hall, and a carved walnut door at the back right leads to the nobles' portrait gallery.

doors.label: La maquette du château
doors.hint: the oak door on the left wall, back to the castle model hall

doors.label: Les nobles
doors.hint: the carved walnut door at the back right, to the nobles' portrait gallery

noblesse.name: La galerie des nobles · The nobles' gallery
noblesse.alt: The nobles' portrait gallery of the castle wing, seen from the near left: honey-colored walnut paneling, rows of gilt-framed portraits (one of a dog in a ruff), a white marble fireplace, crystal chandeliers and a herringbone parquet floor. On the left an elderly lady in a medieval headdress points proudly at a painted map of fields and a manor on an easel, a duke in a powdered wig sneezes into his lace handkerchief, and a boy pushes a baby in a navy baby carriage up to a golden crown in a glass case. In the middle a lady in a huge pink hooped gown arrives with her entourage, two little girls carrying her long train. On the right an old steward wrapped in a woolly gray shawl checks his big ledger, a young viscount in a green sash points at a painting of a V of wild geese, a baron in a red cloak pushes a wheelbarrow of apples, a bearded count in an ermine cape counts beads on an abacus, and a valet in green livery does a dancing step holding a coat on a hanger. A carved walnut door on the left wall leads back to the knights' hall.

doors.label: Les chevaliers
doors.hint: the carved walnut door on the left wall, back to the knights' hall

trone.name: La salle du trône · The throne room
trone.alt: The grand throne room of the castle wing, seen from the near left: red damask walls, white marble columns, crystal chandeliers and a polished marble floor, with a gilded throne on red-carpeted steps at the back. On the left an organist plays a little pipe organ beside trays of neatly sorted music, a traffic cop raises his hand to stop a boy in a red pedal car, an architect points proudly at a white model of a domed building, two opera singers carry a long bench while singing, and a strongman lifts a barbell with a giant green pea on each end. On the right an actor in a toga rehearses on the throne with a script and a bread roll beside a tiny toy throne for the museum mouse, a toddler in a lightning-bolt costume and red cape flexes his arms, a girl in a gold dress sits on a cushioned stone ledge seat, a troll costume ticket checker grins over two tickets, and a man wriggles on his back under the velvet rope while a guard points at a blank rules board. A blue door with a laurel wreath on the back wall leads to the old assembly chamber, a red door beside it leads back to the castle model hall, and a green door with a gold star on the right leads to the leaders' gallery.

doors.label: L'assemblée
doors.hint: the blue door with the laurel wreath on the back wall, to the old assembly chamber

doors.label: La maquette du château
doors.hint: the red door with the laurel wreath beside the throne steps, back to the castle model hall

doors.label: Les dirigeants
doors.hint: the green door with the gold star on the right, to the leaders' gallery

assemblee.name: La salle de l'assemblée · The assembly chamber
assemblee.alt: The old assembly chamber of the castle wing, seen from the near left: curved tiers of blue velvet benches, dark oak paneling, a blue-and-white painted dome and a pale wooden floor, with a giant wooden gavel on the speaker's desk. On the left a girl balances a red flying disc on her head and a toy plane on her hand by the blue door, three boys in blue sashes arrive with a gift basket of fruit, a couple dance with the girl leaning far back, and a man holds up a bunch of colorful feathers. In front two children fit together a giant jigsaw, a girl with a finger on her lips clutches a huge orange crayon, a bearded author signs a slip with a feather quill for a waiting boy, and a librarian at a lectern raises a hand to stop a boy touching a giant dictionary. On the right a committee of three sits at a round table under a model comet hanging on a wire, and a gray-haired dad kneels to hand his son a rolled scroll with a red seal. The blue door on the left leads back to the throne room.

doors.label: La salle du trône
doors.hint: the blue door on the left wall, back to the throne room

dirigeants.name: La galerie des dirigeants · The leaders' gallery
dirigeants.alt: The leaders' gallery of the castle wing, seen from the near left: forest-green walls with white stucco, tall oak bookcases with a rolling library ladder, potted topiary trees and a big topiary bush clipped into a king's chair, on a black-and-white checkerboard marble floor under brass globe lamps. On the left a girl in a bee costume climbs a climbing wall toward a gold star, four acrobats in red leotards form a human pyramid with the top girl cheering, and a gardener clips round topiary balls with shears. In front a man in a patchwork coat plays a flute, a girl in yellow raises her hand high, two little cowboys hug a big gold trophy cup, and a clerk stamps forms at his desk. On the right a girl on the library ladder points the way, a man in a deer-antler hat strides ahead pointing, a critic frowns at an open book, a bare-headed king in a fur-trimmed cape holds his scepter under a toy rain cloud dripping into a bucket, and a delegate with a name badge carries a huge deli sandwich. The green door on the left wall leads back to the throne room.

doors.label: La salle du trône
doors.hint: the green door on the left wall, back to the throne room
